# monotaur_probe (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur probe. Probes collect data from sensors and associate them with a monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_monitor" "api_health" {
  name = "API Health Check"
  type = "Alert"
}

resource "monotaur_probe" "http" {
  monitor_id   = monotaur_monitor.api_health.id
  active       = true
  schedule     = "*/5 8-18 * * 1-5"
  time_zone_id = "Europe/Berlin"
}

# Sensors attach to a probe through their own probe_id; the probe's
# sensor_ids attribute is read-only.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor_id` (String) The ID of the monitor this probe belongs to.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the probe is active.
- `schedule` (String) The schedule expression for the probe (e.g. a cron expression).
- `time_zone_id` (String) The time zone `schedule` is evaluated in, as an IANA ID such as `Europe/Berlin` (Windows IDs are also accepted). Unset means UTC.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the probe was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the probe (assigned by the API).
- `sensor_ids` (List of String) IDs of sensors attached to this probe (read-only). Attach a sensor by setting `probe_id` on the `monotaur_sensor`; the API does not accept sensors on the probe.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the probe was last updated (assigned by the API).
